uq_contracts_parent_child_live.name: uq_contracts_parent_child_live
uq_contracts_parent_child_live.where: parent_id IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('draft','pending','approved','issued')

ck_products_code_norm.name: ck_products_code_norm
ck_products_code_norm.value: length("products"."code_norm") BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND "products"."code_norm" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9._-]*'

ck_products_duration.name: ck_products_duration
ck_products_duration.value: ("products"."kind" = 'goods' AND "products"."duration_value" IS NULL AND "products"."duration_unit" IS NULL) OR ("products"."kind" = 'service' AND (("products"."duration_unit" = 'month' AND "products"."duration_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 120) OR ("products"."duration_unit" = 'day' AND "products"."duration_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 3650)))
